name: Slack
description: Channel messaging, direct messages, thread replies, and notifications.

actions.name: Post Message
actions.description: Sends a message or block-kit payload to a Slack channel.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Channel, private group, or IM channel ID to send message to

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The formatted text of the message to send

parameters.name: thread_ts
parameters.description: Provide another message's ts value to make this message a reply

actions.name: List Conversations
actions.description: Lists public channels in a workspace.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Mix and match channel types: public_channel, private_channel

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return (max 1000)

actions.name: Get Conversation History
actions.description: Fetches a conversation's history of messages and events.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Conversation ID to fetch history for

actions.name: Add Reaction
actions.description: Adds an emoji reaction to a message.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Channel where the message was posted

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Timestamp of the message to react to

actions.name: Set Topic
actions.description: Sets the topic on a specified channel.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Channel ID to set the topic of
